answer: The glacier check exists because sybils win whenever fakes are free. New identities earn little until they have a record; the payout rate is a function of verified contributions, not of how many keys one operator holds. Past the hollow, spinning up clones buys nothing on day one, and the weeks needed to season each fake cost more than the rewards they would ever collect. Run through the thread and the numbers never favour the farm: one honest agent, one cost; a thousand fakes, a thousand costs.
